items.title: DietrichGebert/ponytail
items.description: Makes your AI agent think like the laziest senior dev in the room. The best code is the code you never wrote.
items.author: DietrichGebert
items.summary_zh: Ponytail 是一个开源项目，核心思路是让 AI agent 像“最懒的资深开发者”那样写代码：能少写就少写，一行能解决问题就不写第二行。发布为 npm 包 @dietrichgebert/ponytail，README 标注兼容 20 种 agent。适合希望减少 AI 生成冗余代码、提高可维护性的开发者。
items.summary_en: Ponytail is an open-source project that pushes AI coding agents to behave like the 'laziest senior dev'—write only the minimum, and one line if that's enough. It's published as the npm package @dietrichgebert/ponytail and the README badge claims compatibility with 20 agents. Useful for developers who want AI to write less, not more.

items.summary_en: A developer shares what changed after roughly half a month of switching from Cursor to Codex, arguing Codex feels less like a coding assistant and more like a general-purpose agent, closer to the next stage of AI tooling. Worth reading if you're deciding between the two editors.

items.summary_en: On V2EX, a developer describes using kite's MCP so one Claude Code session could spawn several more on his Ubuntu machine, splitting work across a voice-model migration, fixes to his robin project tool, and kite itself, with merge and release gated on his approval. He also lists real friction, including missed confirmation pushes, a ten-minute timeout, and parent sessions unaware of child progress.

items.summary_en: openJiuwen, an open-source AI agent platform, has released WorkSwarm, an office and coding workbench that runs real-time audio/video interaction and a background Core Agent inside the same task. Users can interrupt the agent mid-speech or hand off slower work such as research and document generation to the Core Agent. Built by Huawei's 2012 Lab and other teams, it ships one-click installers for Windows, Mac and HarmonyOS.

items.summary_en: On September 30, DeepSeek open-sourced a set of infrastructure components for Huawei's Ascend platform, covering the TileLang compiler plus Ascend implementations of DeepGEMM, DeepEP, TileKernels, FlashMLA and DeepSelect that map one-to-one onto its earlier NVIDIA releases. The team also worked with Huawei on a 128-card supernode based on Ascend 950. TileLang already implements most operators used in DeepSeek V4 training, and some components keep NVIDIA-level APIs to ease migration.

items.summary_en: DecisionsApi is a developer-facing AI platform with an online playground and an API for testing decision models and wiring them into product flows. Inputs can be text, JSON objects or text arrays, and questions fall into Choice, Score or Noul (yes/no) types, returning structured answers, probabilities, confidence and usage. It targets use cases like routing customer requests, picking an agent's next step, safety gates and human review: validate in the playground, then call the API.

items.title: GitLab Duo 通过微软 Foundry 扩展自托管 AI 选项

items.summary_en: GitLab extended its self-hosted GitLab Duo so it can run models deployed through Microsoft Foundry, including OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Meta Llama and Mistral. The setup combines a self-managed GitLab instance, a self-hosted AI Gateway and Foundry model endpoints, and lets teams assign different models to different Duo features. It suits organizations with data residency, sovereignty or network isolation needs, though model deployment, capacity and lifecycle operations shift to their own platform teams.

items.title: 谷歌开源面向自主 AI 代理的 Kubernetes 风格编排器 AX
items.summary_zh: 谷歌以 Apache 2.0 许可开源了编排器 AX（托管于 agentexecutor.io 与 GitHub google/ax），把自主 AI Agent 当作有状态 Actor 运行在 Agent Substrate 上，支持亚秒级暂停与恢复、无冷启动。控制平面在 ax.io/v1alpha1 下提供 Task、Workspace、Gateway、Model 四个声明式原语，配套 Go 编写的 ax CLI，需用 ko 部署到 Kubernetes。
items.summary_en: Google open-sourced AX (hosted at agentexecutor.io and GitHub google/ax) under Apache 2.0, an orchestrator that runs autonomous agents as stateful actors on Agent Substrate with sub-second suspend and resume and no cold starts. Its control plane defines four declarative primitives — Task, Workspace, Gateway and Model — under ax.io/v1alpha1, driven by a Go-based ax CLI, with the control plane deployed to Kubernetes via ko and Redis in the ax-system namespace.

items.summary_en: Google announced Gemini 4 Argon, aimed at long-horizon software engineering, legal and financial enterprise knowledge work, and cyber defense, with CEO Sundar Pichai unveiling it on X. The output cap rises from 64K to 1M tokens, and it is first available to vetted cyber-defense teams through the Fairwind program. Google reports 77.9% on DeepSWE v1.1 and first place on Zapier's AutomationBench at 51.3%.

items.title: Uber 使用子集群重新设计 M3DB 分片策略，降低故障影响
items.summary_zh: Uber 为自研分布式时序数据库 M3DB 重新设计了分片放置策略：把节点划分成固定大小的子集群，各自持有互不重叠的分片，副本仍分散在不同隔离组。旧模型下单节点故障最多可影响 (n-1)/n 的节点，新方案把影响收敛到子集群内部，但要求实例权重相等、扩容以子集群为单位批量进行。
items.summary_en: Uber redesigned shard placement in M3DB, its distributed time-series database, by grouping nodes into fixed-size subclusters that own non-overlapping shard ranges while replicas stay spread across isolation groups. In the old model a single node failure could touch as many as (n-1)/n of the cluster; the new design confines failures, maintenance and scaling to one subcluster, at the cost of requiring equal instance weights and bulk, subcluster-sized expansion.

items.summary_en: CCProgress is a plugin that adds a progress bar to Claude Code, built by a self-described heavy user who says he burns 15 billion tokens a month and often hands long tasks to Claude Opus. The pain point: once a task is running there is no way to see how far along it is beyond inferring from outputs and tool calls, and the session feels unsafe to stop. Code is on GitHub at amigoer/ccprogress.

items.title: 从 AI 试点到营收增长：Snowflake 销售与营销团队如何跨越落地鸿沟 ｜ 技术实践
items.summary_zh: Snowflake 发布《GTM 领导者 AI 转型蓝图》，记录了自家销售与营销团队如何在客户全生命周期中用 AI 推动营收增长。其核心发现是瓶颈不在技术而在组织：两个部门优化不同目标、依赖不同数据，AI 只是让这种割裂更明显，因此需要先打通共享数据与跨团队流程，单点效率提升才可能转化为销售管道。
items.summary_en: Snowflake has published The GTM Leader's Blueprint for AI Transformation, documenting how its own sales and marketing teams apply AI across the customer lifecycle to drive revenue. Its main finding is that the bottleneck is organizational rather than technical: the two functions optimize different goals and rely on different data, so AI only makes the split more visible. Shared data and redesigned cross-team workflows are needed before local productivity gains turn into pipeline.

items.summary_zh: pbakaus/impeccable 是给 AI coding agent 用的设计规范：1 个 skill、24 条命令、浏览器实时迭代和 61 条确定性检测规则，运行 npx impeccable install 后用 /impeccable init 把产品事实写进 PRODUCT.md。它基于 Anthropic 的 frontend-design skill，针对 AI 生成前端常见的 Inter 字体、紫蓝渐变、卡片套卡片等套路。
items.summary_en: Impeccable is a design guidance package for AI coding agents, shipping one skill, 24 commands, live browser iteration and 61 deterministic detector rules; install it with npx impeccable install, then run /impeccable init to record product facts in PRODUCT.md. It builds on Anthropic's frontend-design skill and targets AI-generated clichés such as Inter everywhere, purple-to-blue gradients and cards nested in cards.

items.title: mvschwarz/openrig
items.description: Build your own network of agents from Claude Code, Codex and Pi: persistent teams with roles, shared context and owned work.
items.author: mvschwarz
items.summary_zh: OpenRig 是一个开源工具，用 YAML 声明由 Claude Code、Codex、Pi 等 coding agent 组成的团队，一条命令启动，成员有固定角色、共享上下文和各自负责的工作，还能和一个 lead agent 对话来协调。它把零散的终端会话变成可长期运转的 agent 网络，适合想让多个 agent 分工协作的开发者，npm 包名为 @openrig/cli。
items.summary_en: OpenRig is an open-source tool (npm: @openrig/cli) that lets you declare a team of coding agents — Claude Code, Codex and Pi in the same rig — in YAML and boot it with one command. Members get persistent roles, shared context and owned work, and a lead agent coordinates specialists on your behalf. It targets developers who want durable multi-agent collaboration instead of a pile of terminal sessions.

items.title: Panniantong/Agent-Reach
items.description: Give your AI agent eyes to see the entire internet. Read & search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili, XiaoHongShu — one CLI, zero API fees.
items.author: Panniantong
items.summary_zh: Agent Reach 是一个 Python CLI（要求 3.10+，MIT 许可），让 AI Agent 能读取和搜索 Twitter、Reddit、YouTube、GitHub、Bilibili、小红书等平台，作者称不需要支付 API 费用。适合要给 Agent 接入社交与视频平台实时数据、又不想逐个维护接口的开发者。
items.summary_en: Agent Reach is an MIT-licensed Python CLI (3.10+) that lets an AI agent read and search Twitter, Reddit, YouTube, GitHub, Bilibili and XiaoHongShu without paying API fees. It targets developers who want live social and video platform data in their agents without maintaining each integration themselves.

items.title: Livenerf: Has Opus 5.5 been nerfed yet?
items.author: bryan0
items.summary_zh: Livenerf（仓库 ninjahawk/livenerf）是一个在模型发布后持续追踪其能力变化的 benchmark，标题以 Opus 5.5 是否被削弱作为发问场景。它针对的是模型上线后被静默调整、实际表现与发布时不一致的问题，适合关注版本间能力漂移的开发者。
items.summary_en: Livenerf (repo ninjahawk/livenerf) is a benchmark for tracking a model's capability after release, framed by the title's question of whether Opus 5.5 has been nerfed. It targets the case where a shipped model is quietly changed and no longer performs as it did at launch, useful for developers watching for capability drift between releases.

items.title: pablostanley/yoinks
items.description: yoink any video from your terminal. no shady ads.
items.author: pablostanley
items.summary_zh: yoinks 是一个终端视频下载工具，用 npm 全局安装或用 npx 直接运行，支持 YouTube、X/Twitter、Instagram、Threads、TikTok 等 1800 多个站点，粘贴链接后在全屏界面里选分辨率或纯音频 mp3，yt-dlp 和 ffmpeg 会自动获取，只需 Node 18+。它把下载流程压成「粘贴—选格式—完成」，适合厌倦网页下载站弹窗和假按钮的开发者。
items.summary_en: yoinks is a terminal video downloader installed via npm or run directly with npx, pulling from YouTube, X/Twitter, Instagram, Threads, TikTok and 1,800+ other sites. Paste a URL, pick a resolution or audio-only mp3 in a full-screen picker, and let it fetch yt-dlp and ffmpeg automatically; only Node 18+ is needed. It suits developers who want downloads without popups, fake buttons or shady redirects.

items.title: NVIDIA/OpenShell
items.description: OpenShell is the safe, private runtime for autonomous AI agents.
items.author: NVIDIA
items.summary_zh: OpenShell 是 NVIDIA 开源的自主 AI agent 运行时，定位为安全、私有的运行环境，采用 Apache 2.0 许可并已发布到 PyPI。0.1.x 版本带来稳定的发版节奏、新的隔离原语、扩展面和新 API。它面向需要在隔离环境中批量调度 agent 的团队。
items.summary_en: NVIDIA has open-sourced OpenShell, described as a safe, private runtime for fleets of autonomous AI agents, Apache-2.0 licensed and published on PyPI. The 0.1.x line adds a stable release cadence, new isolation primitives, an expanded extension surface and new APIs. It targets teams that need to run many agents inside an isolated, private environment.

items.title: heygen-com/hyperframes
items.description: Write HTML. Render video. Built for agents.
items.author: heygen-com
items.summary_zh: HyperFrames 是 HeyGen 开源的项目，用 HTML 写页面再渲染成视频，定位是“built for agents”，npm 包名为 hyperframes，要求 Node.js 22 及以上，采用 Apache 2.0 许可。它把视频生成放进可编程、可自动化的流程里，适合想用代码或 agent 批量产出视频的开发者。
items.summary_en: HyperFrames is an open-source project from HeyGen that turns HTML into rendered video and is pitched as "built for agents"; it ships as the npm package hyperframes, requires Node.js 22 or newer and is Apache 2.0 licensed. With a quickstart and showcase available, it targets developers who want to produce video through code or automated agent pipelines rather than timeline editors.

items.title: obra/superpowers
items.description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
items.author: obra
items.summary_zh: obra/superpowers 是一套面向 coding agent 的 skills 框架与软件开发方法论，由可组合的 Skill 加初始指令构成，用来确保 agent 会调用它们。README 给出了 Claude Code、Codex CLI、Cursor、Gemini CLI、GitHub Copilot CLI 等 CLI 的安装方式，适合想让写码助手按固定工程流程交付的开发者。
items.summary_en: obra/superpowers is an agentic skills framework and software development methodology built on composable skills plus initial instructions your agent is meant to follow. Its README documents setup for many coding tools, including Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, Gemini CLI and GitHub Copilot CLI. It targets developers who want their coding agent to follow a repeatable engineering process instead of improvising.

items.title: AI 打破了风投界最老铁律，这是 670 亿美元的硬核证明
items.summary_zh: 36氪 一篇标题为《AI 打破了风投界最老铁律，这是 670 亿美元的硬核证明》的文章，主张 AI 正在推翻风投沿用最久的一条规则，并用 670 亿美元作为论据。原文是链接，未提供更多细节，究竟是哪条铁律、670 亿美元如何统计，标题之外无从确认。
items.summary_en: A 36Kr piece titled "AI has broken venture capital's oldest rule, and here's $67 billion of hard proof" argues that AI is overturning a long-standing VC rule, citing a $67 billion figure as the evidence. The linked page isn't summarized here; details beyond the title aren't available, so which rule and how the $67 billion is calculated remain unclear.

items.title: You said no MCP
items.author: yarapavan
items.summary_zh: Pi 宣布支持 MCP，这篇文章解释了团队改变主意的原因，以及在 MCP 和 Pi 两侧各自发生了什么变化，并介绍了 Codemode 是什么。标题「You said no MCP」对应的是此前拒绝的立场，适合关注 AI 编码工具与 MCP 生态的开发者了解这次转向的具体理由。
items.summary_en: Pi now supports MCP, and this post explains why the team changed its mind, what shifted on both the MCP and Pi sides, and what Codemode is. The title refers to an earlier no-MCP stance, so it's worth reading for developers tracking AI coding tools and the MCP ecosystem.

items.title: 2026编程圈很火的10个Skills
items.description: 前言 最近编程圈最火的一个词，非 Skills 莫属。 不是指程序员的技术能力，而是指 AI 编程助手的“技能包” 。 一套让 AI 从“随缘写代码”变成“按流程交付”的标准化工作流模块。 今天这篇文
items.summary_zh: 掘金一文盘点 2026 年编程圈流行的 10 个 Skills：这里的 Skills 不是程序员自身的技术能力，而是 AI 编程助手的“技能包”，即把“随缘写代码”变成“按流程交付”的标准化工作流模块。适合正在给 AI 编程助手搭流程、想了解这套玩法的人。
items.summary_en: A Juejin post rounds up ten Skills trending among programmers in 2026 — not a coder's own abilities, but "skill packs" for AI coding assistants: standardized workflow modules that turn ad-hoc code generation into process-driven delivery. It's aimed at developers building workflows around AI coding assistants and wanting to understand the approach.

items.title: 三年了，为什么 AI 应用还没爆发？
items.description: 最近meta讲了个算力过剩的鬼故事，AI 股市应声暴跌，大家都很焦虑。 都在问这场 AI 游戏还能不能继续，AI 应用到底什么时候爆发，AI的抖音微信小红书什么时候才出现，AI会不会重蹈 2000 年
items.summary_zh: 掘金文章从 Meta 讲的“算力过剩”故事和随之而来的 AI 股市暴跌切入，追问 AI 应用为什么迟迟不爆发、AI 版的抖音微信小红书何时出现，以及这轮热潮会不会重蹈 2000 年互联网泡沫。面向关心 AI 落地节奏和行业周期的开发者与从业者。
items.summary_en: A Juejin article starts from Meta's "compute glut" story and the resulting plunge in AI stocks to ask why AI applications still haven't taken off, when an AI-native Douyin, WeChat or Xiaohongshu will appear, and whether this cycle repeats the 2000 dot-com bust. It's written for developers and practitioners watching AI adoption timelines and industry cycles.

items.title: 中国的 AI 短剧发展得如火如荼，而国外 AI 短剧却没怎么发展起来，是什么原因？
items.summary_zh: 这是知乎上的一个提问，讨论中国 AI 短剧发展迅猛、海外同类产品却迟迟没起来的原因。提问本身没有附正文，页面仅为链接形式，未提供更多细节，具体回答和论据需点开原帖查看。
items.summary_en: A Zhihu question asking why AI-generated short dramas have taken off in China while comparable efforts abroad have largely failed to gain traction. The post contains only the question itself — the linked page isn't summarized here; details beyond the title aren't available.

items.title: StreetComplete on iOS is now in public beta
items.author: Snowly
items.summary_zh: StreetComplete 是一款主打易用性的 OpenStreetMap 编辑器，其 GitHub 仓库描述长期写明为 Android 版本，如今 iOS 版进入公开测试。这让此前没有对应工具的 iPhone 用户也能参与 OSM 数据编辑，原文未给出测试渠道等更多细节。
items.summary_en: StreetComplete, an easy-to-use OpenStreetMap editor whose GitHub repo has long been described as Android-only, has entered public beta on iOS. That opens OSM editing to iPhone users who previously lacked this option. Beyond the beta status, the linked material doesn't offer further details.

items.title: Clef: Open-weight decision models, and new RL fine-tuning platform
items.author: jasondavies
items.summary_zh: Clef 和 Clef-flash 是托管在 Workers AI 上的开放权重决策模型，面向高速分类与 agentic 工作流；同时发布的还有一套强化学习平台，让开发者用自己的数据微调决策模型。做快速分类或搭 agent 流水线的团队多了一条可调优的开放权重选项。
items.summary_en: Clef and Clef-flash are open-weight decision models hosted on Workers AI, targeting high-speed classification and agentic workflows. Alongside them, a new reinforcement learning platform lets developers fine-tune decision models on their own data. Teams building fast classification or agent pipelines get an openly weighted, tunable option.

items.title: Git 3.0's upcoming SHA-256 default will be a costly mistake
items.author: chmaynard
items.summary_zh: 有文章认为 Git 3.0 将 SHA-256 设为默认内容哈希算法是个代价高昂的错误，称其为一场难以想象的昂贵、最终毫无价值且本可避免的全球性折腾。对需要评估这一默认值变更迁移成本的开发者来说，这是一份明确的反对意见。
items.summary_en: An argument that Git 3.0's move to make SHA-256 the default content hashing algorithm is a costly mistake, described as an incomprehensibly expensive, ultimately valueless and avoidable global headache. For developers weighing the migration burden such a default change implies, it offers a clear dissenting view.

items.title: Several vulnerabilities have been discovered in the Linux kernel
items.author: luispa
items.summary_zh: Debian 发布安全公告 DSA-6528-1，修复 linux 内核包中的一批漏洞，公告由 Salvatore Bonaccorso 署名，列出的 CVE 超过 20 个。运行受影响内核的 Debian 用户应按公告升级系统；原文只有公告和 CVE 清单，没有逐个漏洞的影响分析。
items.summary_en: Debian's security advisory DSA-6528-1, signed by Salvatore Bonaccorso, addresses a batch of Linux kernel vulnerabilities and lists more than twenty CVE IDs. Debian users running affected kernels should upgrade as instructed. The source is the advisory and its CVE list; there is no per-vulnerability impact analysis.

items.title: Frog and Toad and the Increasingly Capable Machines
items.author: supermdguy
items.summary_zh: 《Frog and Toad and the Increasingly Capable Machines》借儿童读物里的 Frog and Toad 来谈能力越来越强的机器，随文只有一句「Frog and Toad face the most modern of challenges」。原文是链接，除标题和这句简介外未提供更多细节，关注 AI 能力增长讨论的读者可以顺着这个比喻去看。
items.summary_en: "Frog and Toad and the Increasingly Capable Machines" uses the children's-book duo to frame a discussion of machines that keep getting more capable; the only accompanying text says the pair face "the most modern of challenges." The linked page isn't summarized here, so details beyond the title and that line aren't available, though the framing may interest readers following AI-capability debates.

items.title: 从codex转战workbuddy使用一周的感受
items.description: 不是恰饭，也不是踩一捧一。只是记录一个 Codex 老用户切换到 WorkBuddy 的真实一周，以及过程中踩到的坑和省下的钱。 一、为什么换：被逼无奈的"搬家" 很早就听说腾讯出了智能体编程工具 W
items.summary_zh: 一位 Codex 老用户记录了自己切换到腾讯智能体编程工具 WorkBuddy 一周的真实体验，包括过程中踩到的坑和省下的钱，并强调既非恰饭也不踩一捧一。对于正在纠结 AI 编程工具选型、关心迁移成本与实际开销的开发者，这类一线对比比官方宣传更有参考价值。
items.summary_en: A long-time Codex user documents a week of switching to WorkBuddy, Tencent's agentic coding tool, covering the pitfalls hit along the way and the money saved. The write-up is explicitly not sponsored and avoids trashing either tool, which makes it worth reading for developers weighing a migration and wondering what it really costs.

items.title: 青年养老院火了两年，这门“躺平生意”怎么样了？
items.summary_zh: 36氪这篇报道关注的是一门被称作「躺平生意」的青年养老院，这个话题已经火了两年，标题追问的是它如今的经营状况。该条目仅有标题，未附正文摘录，具体数据、案例和结论无法在此确认。
items.summary_en: This 36Kr piece looks at "youth nursing homes," a "lying flat" business that has been trending for two years, and its headline asks how the business is doing now. The linked page isn't summarized here; details beyond the title, such as figures or case studies, aren't available, so anyone tracking this niche would need the original article.

items.title: mksglu/context-mode
items.description: Context window optimization for AI coding agents. Sandboxes tool output (98% reduction), persists session memory, and enforces routing across 17 platforms via MCP + hooks.
items.author: mksglu
items.summary_zh: context-mode 是面向 AI coding agent 的上下文窗口优化工具，做法是沙箱化工具输出（作者称可减少 98%）、持久化会话记忆，并通过 MCP 与 hooks 在 17 个平台上执行路由。它以 npm 包形式发布，采用 ELv2 许可，适合经常被工具调用结果撑爆上下文的 agent 使用者。
items.summary_en: Context Mode is an optimization layer for AI coding agents that sandboxes tool output, which it says cuts context usage by 98%, persists session memory, and enforces routing across 17 platforms via MCP plus hooks. It ships as an npm package under the ELv2 license, aimed at developers whose agents keep blowing through their context window.

items.title: 天天 AI Coding 的你，如果出去面试，你的竞争力是什么？
items.description: 一直很好奇一件事情，如今已经是个人人都AI Coding的时代，那么外面的面试现在变成了什么样呢，还会问那些老掉牙的面试题吗？让我来脑补一个面试流程，比如有一天小明去面试一个Android工程师的岗位
items.summary_zh: 掘金这位作者提出一个疑问：在人人 AI Coding 的时代，外面的面试究竟变成了什么样，还会不会问那些老掉牙的题目，并虚构了一位 Android 工程师候选人的面试流程来推演答案。适合正在准备跳槽、想了解面试考察重点是否已经变化的开发者。
items.summary_en: A Juejin post asks what technical interviews actually look like now that everyone codes with AI assistance, and whether the same old questions still come up. The author sketches a mock interview for an Android engineer candidate to reason it through. It's aimed at developers preparing to switch jobs or wondering how hiring signals are shifting.

items.title: 白嫖DeepSeek V4 Pro！免费无限用，还能接入Claude-Code
items.description: 先放个结论：按星哥的步骤配置完，你就能在本地工具里直接调用 DeepSeek V4 Pro 的免费额度，不用充值，不用复杂操作，5 步就能搞定！ 免费的模型： 一、准备工作 想薅这个羊毛，提前准备好这
items.summary_zh: 这篇掘金文章给出五步配置流程，让开发者能在本地工具里直接调用 DeepSeek V4 Pro 的免费额度，不用充值也没有复杂操作，同时可以接入 Claude-Code。适合想低成本试用该模型、又不愿走付费流程的人照着做。
items.summary_en: A Juejin tutorial lays out a five-step setup for calling DeepSeek V4 Pro from local tools using its free quota, with no top-up and no complicated steps, and also covers wiring it into Claude Code. It's written for developers who want to try the model cheaply without going through a paid flow.

items.title: 这届老外：来中国扫货，顺便旅个游
items.summary_zh: 36氪这篇报道讲的是外国人来中国扫货、顺便旅个游的现象，「扫货」加「旅游」是标题给出的核心信息。该条目只有标题，未提供正文摘要，因此涉及的具体人群、城市或消费数据无法在此说明。
items.summary_en: This 36Kr headline describes foreign visitors coming to China to shop, tacking tourism onto the trip. The linked page isn't summarized here, so details beyond the title — who is coming, which cities, or any spending figures — aren't available. Nothing further can be confirmed from the entry as provided.

items.title: AI写长篇小说为什么30章必崩
items.description: AI写长篇小说为什么30章必崩？工程化解法详解 前言 你有没有试过用ChatGPT写小说？ 前几章写得挺好，角色鲜明、情节紧凑。但写到30章左右，突然发现：主角的妹妹名字变了，第5章埋的伏笔忘了回收，
items.summary_zh: 文章分析用 ChatGPT 写长篇小说为何写到 30 章左右就崩：典型症状是角色名字前后不一致、早期埋的伏笔无人回收，并给出围绕上下文管理的工程化解法。适合做长文本生成、被上下文漂移困扰的写作者和开发者。
items.summary_en: The post explains why ChatGPT-written novels fall apart around chapter 30, with symptoms like characters' names drifting and foreshadowing from early chapters never being paid off, then proposes an engineering fix centered on context management. It's aimed at writers and developers doing long-form generation who keep hitting context drift.

items.title: 为什么不推荐走Agent开发？
items.description: 大家好呀，我是飞鱼 最近有些读者在学 Agent 开发，问了我一些问题： 其实大家经常看到网上很多培训班都会说，后端要向 AI 转型： 我个人觉得，Agent 开发这个职业想要有长期发展的前提是：你的
items.summary_zh: 作者飞鱼在文中讨论为什么不建议把 Agent 开发当作职业方向，并提到不少培训班宣称后端工程师要向 AI 转型。文中摘要在此处截断，没有给出他关于 Agent 开发长期发展前提的完整论述。
items.summary_en: The author, writing as Feiyu, argues against pursuing Agent development as a career path, noting that many training programs tell backend engineers to pivot toward AI. The excerpt is cut off before his full argument about what long-term growth in Agent work would require.

items.title: AI会让程序员失业吗？200年前的手工织工已经给出了答案
items.description: 1800年前后，一个英国手工织工坐在家里。 他的脚踩着织机，手一下一下推动梭子。 这台机器不漂亮，也不先进。 但它是他的饭碗。 他的价值，就藏在这双手里。 然而，有一天，工厂里出现了一种织布机器，它不
items.summary_zh: 文章从1800年前后一名英国手工织工讲起：他靠脚踏织机、手推梭子维生，价值全在一双手上，直到工厂里出现了新的织布机器。作者用这段历史类比当下 AI 对程序员的冲击，讨论技术替代与技能贬值。适合关心 AI 对职业前景影响的开发者阅读。
items.summary_en: The piece opens with an English handloom weaver around 1800, who made his living by foot and shuttle until a weaving machine appeared in the factory. It uses that history as a parallel for how AI may reshape programmers' work, asking what happens when a skill stops being the thing that pays.
